title: Tutorials for Introduction to Modern Statistics
text: recommended way launch tutorials R Tutorials extension VS Code, lists every installed tutorial lets start one click. backup, can launch tutorial R console learnr2::run_tutorial(), providing short name tutorial package name. Hello Data (“hello-data”). Chapter 1: stent experiment, cases variables loan50, associations among US counties, experiments versus observational studies. Study Design (“study-design”). Chapter 2: populations samples, simple random, stratified, convenience sampling mlb salaries; random assignment, blinding, placebos stent experiment; confounding county. Applications: Data (“applications-data”). Chapter 3: getting know paralympic_1500, Simpson’s paradox 1500m gold medal times. Exploring Categorical Data (“exploring-categorical-data”). Chapter 4: contingency tables, bar plots, conditional proportions loans_full_schema, comparing county incomes across groups. Exploring Numerical Data (“exploring-numerical-data”). Chapter 5: histograms, shape, summary statistics loan50, transformations intensity maps county. Applications: Explore (“applications-explore”). Chapter 6: keeping plots simple, using color draw attention, telling story chapter’s company expenses Duke hiring data, order, labels, purpose, color Brexit poll. Linear Regression Single Predictor (“linear-regression-single”). Chapter 7: fitting least squares line, residuals, correlation, R-squared, two-level categorical predictor, outliers, possum, elmhurst, mariokart. Linear Regression Multiple Predictors (“linear-regression-multiple”). Chapter 8: indicator categorical predictors, many predictors, adjusted R-squared, backward forward selection, modeling interest rates loans_full_schema. Logistic Regression (“logistic-regression”). Chapter 9: callback rates resume hiring experiment, logit, logistic models one many predictors, predicted probabilities, groups different sizes. Applications: Model (“applications-model”). Chapter 10: case study house prices duke_forest, correlation one-predictor model multiple regression chosen backward elimination. Hypothesis Testing Randomization (“hypothesis-testing-randomization”). Chapter 11: hypotheses, randomization tests, null distributions, p-values, statistical discernibility, sex_discrimination opportunity_cost experiments. Confidence Intervals Bootstrapping (“confidence-intervals-bootstrap”). Chapter 12: bootstrapping proportion bootstrap percentile confidence intervals, chapter’s medical consultant tappers--listeners case studies, simulation 95% confidence means. Inference Mathematical Models (“inference-mathematical-models”). Chapter 13: Central Limit Theorem, normal model, standard errors, normal-based tests intervals, checked simulation, opportunity_cost stent30. Decision Errors (“decision-errors”). Chapter 14: two-sided tests, Type 1 Type 2 errors, discernibility level, power, simulated cpr blood-thinner experiment. Applications: Foundations (“applications-foundations”). Chapter 15: randomization test 20-volunteer malaria vaccine trial, malaria, comparing data, randomization, bootstrap distributions. Inference Single Proportion (“inference---single-proportion”). Chapter 16: bootstrap test proportion normal model (success-failure condition, confidence intervals, Z test), chapter’s medical consultant payday loan polls. Inference Comparing Two Proportions (“comparing-two-proportions”). Chapter 17: randomization tests, bootstrap intervals, normal model difference proportions, pooled unpooled standard errors, using cpr, fish_oil_18, mammogram. Inference Two-Way Tables (“inference-two-way-tables”). Chapter 18: expected counts, chi-squared statistic, randomization test independence, chi-squared distribution, using ask diabetes2. Inference Single Mean (“inference-single-mean”). Chapter 19: bootstrap t-distribution intervals t-test mean, using chapter’s sample 100 runners run17. Inference Comparing Two Independent Means (“comparing-independent-means”). Chapter 20: randomization tests, bootstrap intervals, t-distribution difference means, using classdata, stem_cell, births14. Inference Comparing Paired Means (“comparing-paired-means”). Chapter 21: paired data, randomization within pairs, bootstrap intervals, paired t-test, using UCLA Bookstore Amazon textbook prices ucla_textbooks_f18. Inference Comparing Many Means (“comparing-many-means”). Chapter 22: ANOVA randomization test F statistic F distribution, using classdata -base percentage position mlb_players_18. Applications: Infer (“applications-infer”). Chapter 23: redundant-adjectives experiment, bootstrap interval one mean, paired randomization test, tests two independent means, checked t-distribution. Inference Linear Regression Single Predictor (“regression-single-inference”). Chapter 24: randomization tests bootstrap intervals slope, t-test, t-interval, model conditions, using births14, midterms_house, elmhurst. Inference Linear Regression Multiple Predictors (“regression-multiple-inference”). Chapter 25: regression output many predictors loans_full_schema, multicollinearity, cross-validation penguins. Inference Logistic Regression (“logistic-regression-inference”). Chapter 26: inference logistic regression coefficients, model diagnostics, cross-validation spam models, using email. Applications: Model Infer (“applications-model-infer”). Chapter 27: case study Mario Kart auctions mariokart, regression output, permutation test bootstrap slope, cross-validation.
